name: table-export
description: Buttons right under each markdown table in Claude's replies: one main export button (TSV by default) and a More button for CSV, Markdown, box-drawing text, HTML and PNG

saveDir.title: CSV folder
saveDir.description: Folder where Save table n CSV writes its files. Absolute path, or starting with ~/ for your home folder. Empty uses ~/Downloads.

defaultFormat.title: Main button
defaultFormat.description: What the main button under each table does: tsv (copy as TSV), csv (save as CSV), md (copy the markdown), art (copy as box-drawing text), html (copy as HTML, macOS), png (copy as an image, macOS). The others stay under More.
